name: Thread checkmarks
author: shazbot
label: Checkmark on subbed mags
desc:
Append a checkmark to magazines on the thread index you are subscribed to.

Depending on the amount of subscriptions, it might take a long time for all checkmarks to appear. If Caching is enabled, results will be saved and reused the next time, providing instant results.

fields.label: Caching
fields.checkbox_label: Enable (turning this off clears the cache)
